title: Stephanie Pomboy: Did Things Just Get A Whole Lot Worse?

excerpts.label: War amplifies pre-existing forces — not a new shock
excerpts.insight: Pomboy says her 2026 thesis (higher commodities, higher yields) hasn't changed — the Iran war only accelerates both vectors and adds recession + credit crisis risk
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STAY COURSE on hard assets and vol. War didn't reset the macro — it accelerated it. Don't let news cycle distract from the secular thesis.

excerpts.label: Private credit: final innings of extend-and-pretend
excerpts.insight: 4 years of continuation funds, secondaries, and toxic ETF packaging are ending — write-downs are starting; the damage will not stay contained in private credit
excerpts.pm_takeaway: SHORT LQD or buy puts. Private credit opacity has masked the damage since 2022. The cascade into public IG markets is the next shoe to drop.

excerpts.label: BBB investment grade — the hidden time bomb
excerpts.insight: Over half the IG market is BBB (one notch above junk). Oracle, Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, CVS, Amgen, Boeing, GM are all BBB. One downgrade triggers forced selling by IG funds
excerpts.pm_takeaway: MONITOR Oracle, VZ, T, GM, Boeing for downgrade risk. Any BBB-to-junk event forces IG fund liquidations — a fire sale that spreads to equities. This is the credit cascade trigger.

excerpts.label: 10Y yields ROSE after Iran — no flight to safety
excerpts.insight: Post-Iran, 10-year Treasury yield rose 22bps instead of falling. Global appetite for US Treasuries is near non-existent — watch yields not spreads
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BEARISH Treasuries. The safe-haven bid is gone. Focus on yield levels, not credit spreads — nominal yields rising means the $1.2T refinancing wall gets more dangerous every week.

excerpts.label: Tax refunds monetizing oil spike — CPI upside risk
excerpts.insight: The oil spike is arriving precisely during peak tax refund season, which cushions consumers but risks fully monetizing the price increase straight into CPI — constraining Fed
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE rate cut bets. Tax refunds absorbing the gas price spike means inflation doesn't get dampened naturally. CPI could surprise higher — Fed stays frozen longer than the market expects.

excerpts.label: Pomboy's allocation: hard assets only
excerpts.insight: Gold, miners, energy — stays in commodities exclusively domestically. Nothing else 'blows her skirt up' that isn't tied to hard assets
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY gold miners on pullbacks. STAY long energy. This is Pomboy's highest conviction domestic allocation — hard assets secular tailwinds only strengthening post-war.

excerpts.label: The Icarus answer — vulnerabilities exposed, not new
excerpts.insight: Pomboy's direct answer to 'did everything get worse': No — markets have been flying blind like Icarus. Wings melting now. Nothing fundamentally new — pressures just amplified
excerpts.pm_takeaway: HOLD vol. The bear thesis hasn't changed — it's being confirmed. Don't cover hedges on relief rallies. The exposure of vulnerabilities IS the catalyst — the regime shift has begun.
